sn3.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn3.1:1.3: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn3.1:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn3.1:1.5: bhavampi no gotamo anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paṭijānātī?ti.
sn3.1:1.6: yaṃ hi taṃ mahārāja sammā vadamāno vadeyya, anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti, mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
sn3.1:1.7: ahaṃ hi mahārāja anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti.
sn3.1:2.1: ye’pi te bho gotama samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa. seyyathīdaṃ:
sn3.1:2.2: pūraṇo kassapo, makkhali gosālo, nigaṇṭho nātaputto, sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto, pakudho kaccāyano, ajito kesakambalo.
sn3.1:2.3: te’pi “mayā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhāti paṭijānāthā”ti puṭṭhā samānā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhāti na paṭijānanti.
sn3.1:2.4: kiṃ pana bhavaṃ gotamo daharo ceva jātiyā navo ca pabbajjāyāti.
sn3.1:3.1: cattāro kho, me mahārāja daharāti na uññātabbā, daharāti na paribhotabbā.
sn3.1:3.3: khattiyo kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo, daharoti na paribhotabbo.
sn3.1:3.4: urago kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo, daharoti na paribhotabbo.
sn3.1:3.5: aggi kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo, daharoti na paribhotabbo.
sn3.1:3.6: bhikkhu kho mahārāja daharoti na uññātabbo, daharoti na paribhotabbo.
sn3.1:3.7: ime kho mahārāja cattāro daharāti na uññātabbā, daharāti na paribhotabbāti.
sn3.1:4.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
sn3.1:14.1: evaṃ vutte rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn3.1:14.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn3.1:14.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn3.1:14.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
